newsitem.title: GERMANY: LB Schleswig-Holstein to buy stake in Hamburg bank.
newsitem.headline: LB Schleswig-Holstein to buy stake in Hamburg bank.

text.p: Landesbank Schleswig-Holstein, a state-owned German regional bank, said on Tuesday it was acquiring a 49.5 percent stake in Hamburgische Landesbank for 1.35 billion marks ($773.2 million).

The purchase comes amid consolidation in the German banking sector, particularly among publicly-owned banks. Two other state-owned banks, Norddeutsche Landesbank and Bankgesellschaft Berlin AG, announced recently they planned to merge. ($ = 1.746 German Marks)

Landesbank Schleswig-Holstein said in a statement the purchase opened up possibilities for cooperation in all market segments and forged a strategic alliance geared towards serving clients in northern and northeastern Europe.
Norddeutsche Landesbank and Hamburger Sparkasse, a savings bank, had both been interested in acquiring the stake in Hamburgische Landesbank.
